policy.storage: roms/ is gitignored (.gitignore:2) and no dump is ever committed; this file records only identity, revision and role
policy.provenance: the operator supplies each dump; the pipeline never downloads a ROM and never runs repository code that reads one
policy.role: a ROM fixes WHICH revision a decomp repository pins, so a recipe can name the exact bytes later verification compares against. A ROM is never model input and never a training example.
policy.verification: sha1/md5 of the local dump against the hash the project itself publishes (its verification file, its decomp.yaml, or its README)

roms.yield_today: 983 pairs from 46 of 47 source files. The extraction step (tools/sandbox_extract.py) builds DKR's own asset tool inside a no-network sandbox and takes back only include/asset_enums.h; without it the same grab yields 20 pairs from 6 files. The 47th file, src/get_stack_pointer.c, needs the repository's per-file -dollar flag, which the recipe now carries. 143 exact and 20 near duplicates of Snowboard Kids code were rejected by the contamination guard.
